scenes.heading: NEVER MEANT *FOR FRIENDS*
scenes.sub: Co-op Anything · turns solo games co-op
scenes.say: Your favourite single-player game was never meant for friends. An AI agent can now change that.

scenes.heading: MEET *CO-OP ANYTHING*
scenes.sub: Point your agent at any game
scenes.say: It is called Co-op Anything: a playbook and toolkit that turns solo games into co-op.

scenes.heading: HOW IT *WORKS*
scenes.say: Tell your agent which game. It studies the game, builds or fixes the co-op, tests it with bots, then packages it so friends join in one click.

scenes.heading: GAMERS *NOTICED*
scenes.say: Gamers gave it more than three hundred GitHub stars in its first two days.

scenes.heading: *ONE SENTENCE*
scenes.say: Setup is one sentence to your coding agent: read this repo — I want this game in co-op.

scenes.heading: BEFORE YOU *GET EXCITED*
cons: Your game may not be built yet
The agent does real work — results vary
scenes.say: The honest catch: unless your game is already done, the agent has real building work ahead, and results vary. But Deus Ex is already released, and it is free and open source.
Which solo game deserves co-op first? Comment Coop and follow for tools like this.

youtube.description:
Co-op Anything turns single-player games into co-op: point your AI coding agent at the repo, name your game, and it studies, builds and bot-tests the multiplayer for you. Deus Ex co-op is already released, Ocarina of Time is fully synced, and Fallout: New Vegas story co-op is in the works — with one-click joins for friends and no port forwarding.

For gamers who always wished their favourite solo game had multiplayer — and for AI-agent fans who want a project with a real payoff.

Repo: https://github.com/cranebeaker/coop-anything

Licence: MIT (free and open source).
